plan.title: Convert to Auction offered on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two vendor bids; prepared-state cases must start here.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage's Settings menu.
Verify Convert to Auction is offered and clickable on the live RFQ.
Open the conversion window without yet confirming the conversion.
Assert that clicking Convert to Auction opens its window.
Cancel the conversion so the RFQ remains unchanged.
Confirm the buyer remains on the RFQ summary after cancellation.
